name: SPEC-03 AMF1 vectors, version 1
notes: Every implementation of SPEC-03 section 6.2 (desktop/frontend/src/voice/mediaFrame.ts, screenFrame.ts, vp8.ts and callPayload.ts, and the reader core/tests/amf1_vectors.rs) MUST give these results.
Binary values are lowercase hex; UUIDs are lowercase canonical and enter the metadata as their 16 bytes in RFC 9562 order.

headers: SFrame headers (RFC 9605 section 4.3) with KID < 2^32 and CTR < 2^48; headers_out_of_range: RFC 9605 Appendix C.1 headers outside those limits, given with KID and CTR as 16 hex digits, which AMF1 v1 decoders reject.
rfc9605_c3: the suite 0x0005 vector of RFC 9605 Appendix C.3 (16-byte base key). key_schedule: deriveEpochKeys of section 6.2.4.
frames are audio frames (media kind 0x01) whose base_key is the epoch secret; plaintext is codec byte and payload.

negative and video_negative: the receiver of section 6.2.6 or 6.2.8 with the keys of context.kind derived for the frame's KID from the context secret, and metadata built from the context; stage names the first failing check: length (step 2), format or kind (step 3), header (step 4), aead (step 7 or 8), fragment (section 6.2.8 step 10, the rules of section 6.2.7).

call_payloads: the body rules of sections 6.3.2 to 6.3.5 and REQ-12, received from fixed.sender_id in fixed.channel_id; the plaintext is the call tag and the JSON as UTF-8. Classification itself is SPEC-02's (typed-plaintext-v1.json).
screen_base: screenBase(epoch_secret) of section 6.2.4. video_key_schedule: keysFor(0x02, epoch_secret, kid), with keysFor(0x01, ...) beside it as audio_key and audio_salt.
video_fragments: AMF1 media kind 0x02 fragments whose plaintext is the 18-byte header of section 6.2.7 and the payload.

screen_wire: binary relay messages of section 6.12.2; direction up is SCREEN_UP (client to relay), down is SCREEN_DOWN (relay to client). Only size and type byte are checked; the fragment is opaque at this layer.
vp8_headers: the checks of section 6.2.9 (vp8TagOk with the given key flag; for a key frame also vp8KeySize equal to width and height and within the caps).
